root_cause: last_element() uses index len(items) - 0 instead of len(items) - 1, returning an IndexError on non-empty lists.
explanation: The function last_element(items) attempts to access items[len(items)] which is one past the final valid index. Python list indexing is zero-based, so the last element is at index len(items) - 1. Using len(items) raises an IndexError for any non-empty list. Changing the index expression to len(items) - 1 corrects the off-by-one error.
